title: Demo data
description: Optional first-run seed so starters look alive. Gated by EXPO_PUBLIC_SEED_DEMO; not for production catalogues.

EXPO_PUBLIC_SEED_DEMO.description: Set to true to seed sample documents on first signed-in launch

notes: Enable with `radiance init --demo`, `radiance add demo-data`, or EXPO_PUBLIC_SEED_DEMO=true.
Starters overlay lib/demo-content.ts with domain documents.
The callable writes once per seed version (meta at _radiance/demo). Nested likes live under posts/{id}/likes.
